answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 29747 Country: India Title: My house given for rent, when I increase the security money and decrease the rent of the house, is it halal or harm . 2My house give for using another person, only bring security,what is the rulling. Question: 1.my house given for rent, when I increase the security money and decrease the rent of the house, is it halal or harm . 2My house give for using another person, only bring security,what is the rulling. Answer ID: 29747 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 268/268/M=1432) (1) By security money, if you mean the pagdi and advanced amount of the house. It is not right to increase it and decrease the house rent; it falls under riba (interest): كل قرض جر نفعاً فهو ربو (2) You can give your house to others for the sake of safety whether without any charge or on rent. However, it is not lawful to have interest based dealing. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
